summary: Round-2 results review of the matched 100k Ada baseline recorded at 596b17248. All required artifacts are present in notes/sim10_ada_100k_baseline_20261110: scope.md, README.md, status.json, results.json, audit.json (status pass), runtime-evidence.json, artifact-index.json, complete.json (status pass, six cases in order preflight-1, preflight-2, 1,2,2,1), cleanup.json (removed true), gpu-tests.json (exit 0, 31 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped), slurm-completed.txt and slurm-job.txt (job 44189224 COMPLETED 0:0, sdfada016, 16:04:39 to 16:20:29, 15m50s, WorkDir equals the shared artifact root). Arithmetic verified: one-stream median 3.0192892363 GiB/s is the mean of 3.0186967095 and 3.0198817630; two-stream median 2.8700860010 is the mean of 2.8618884551 and 2.8782835470; the two-stream change is -4.9417%; median seconds 103.5862/108.9721 and median events/s 965.379/917.674 follow from the per-case values; 335820000000 bytes / 2^30 = 312.7567 GiB and divided by 103.6065 s gives 3.0187 GiB/s; the 10k comparison medians 3.4094/3.2694 are in notes/sim10_ada_baseline_20261110/results.json and the 100k medians are 11.44%/12.21% lower as stated. Per-pass evidence is uniform across the four full passes: 500000 requests, 335820000000 requested and completed bytes, read-size histogram {524724:100000, 629664:100000, 734604:300000} summing to 3358200 bytes per event, 1000 callbacks of 100, 100000 unique timestamps matching the reference, callbacks matching, zero pressure drains, zero CPU reads, peak outstanding 500 requests / 335820000 bytes, drain closed with zero pending/active/held, zero resident JF pages in both initial and conditioned snapshots for all five files, NIC RX 354845368707 to 354971658576 bytes (330.476 to 330.593 GiB, 1.05665 to 1.05703 times requested) on enp69s0f0np0 only, idle RX 0.996 to 1.079 MiB/s, and NIC bracket durations slightly exceeding loop timers in every pass. Controls match the 10k baseline: same GPU UUID GPU-075afbaf-4e77-c882-8d56-bd1dc489b71a, L40S, cores 0-23 with NUMA interleave on all three ranks, KvikIO 26.10 compat ON with 8 threads / 1 MiB tasks / 16 MiB bounce / auto direct I/O off, batch 100, SMD 1000, 512 KiB bulk, 6 GiB budget. runtime-evidence.json shows every module's observed SHA256 equal to the expected receipt, 225 native sources checked, exactly one allow-listed config mismatch (psana/meson.build), ten staged files with sizes summing to 335820951264 JF bytes, wekafs FFB mount, and the chosen UUID drawn from an exclusive 10-GPU allocation as the README discloses. Raw result hashes in results.json agree with artifact-index.json. README claims are hedged appropriately: no causal attribution of the 100k-vs-10k gap, no storage ceiling, no kernel-overlap claim, backend caches and SMD warmth stated as uncontrolled. Prior findings ADA-08/ADA-09 remain closed; BDS-02 did not materialise (cleanup succeeded) and the README now carries the orphan-recovery path and timing allowance; ADA-11 deferral is supported by the recorded Slurm WorkDir. One new low, non-blocking housekeeping finding: status.json still reports checks.gpu_execution as pending although job_state, results_audit and gpu_tests in the same file record completion. The recorded results are accepted as a two-repeat-per-setting baseline with the stated limitations; no further compute is requested.
